author: SickProdigy
description: Configurable donation information command for Discord servers.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores guild donation display settings such as payment method labels, links, addresses, and public notes. It does not store donor records or payment history.
install_msg: Use `[p]donate` to show the default SickGaming donation card, or `[p]donate set` to customize methods. This cog only displays donation information; verified donor roles or account upgrades should be handled by a separate integration.
name: Donate
